=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- Requirement: "implement the default-off flag in plan.yml and both poller stall-recovery approval branches ... gate it behind AUTOMATION_PATH_PLAN_AUTO_APPROVAL_ENABLED".
  Expected change site: the env block of the poller step in .github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml, for example AUTOMATION_PATH_PLAN_AUTO_APPROVAL_ENABLED: ${{ vars.AUTOMATION_PATH_PLAN_AUTO_APPROVAL_ENABLED || 'false' }}.
  Evidence of absence: a search of .github/workflows/ finds the variable only in plan.yml (lines 63, 2134 and 2363). The poller workflow never forwards it, so scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh (line 142) always defaults it to "false". Setting the repo variable therefore never turns on the gate in either poller branch directly; the poller enables it only when it finds a trusted hold marker newer than the plan. If plan.yml's marker post fails (gh_retry failure only logs ::warning::), or the plan step was skipped, stall recovery auto-approves an ungranted automation plan 60 minutes later even with the flag on. README and agents.md document this as an interim state, and the issue's files_touched grant does not cover orchestrate_poll.yml. So this belongs in a follow-up issue, not a fix in this PR, but the deliverable is still missing.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- Requirement: "implement the default-off flag in plan.yml and both poller stall-recovery approval branches" gated behind `AUTOMATION_PATH_PLAN_AUTO_APPROVAL_ENABLED`, where the two poller branches reuse "the existing path classifier and trusted exact-grant parser to deny and report ungranted paths."
  Expected change site: `.github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml`, poller job environment forwarding `AUTOMATION_PATH_PLAN_AUTO_APPROVAL_ENABLED`.
  Evidence of absence: `.github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml` does not forward the variable; `scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:142` defaults it to `false`. Marker-based activation in the poller only fires when the hold marker comment was successfully posted. If `gh_retry` fails on that comment post and the repo var is later set to `true`, the poller's auto-approve branches will run without the gate (no flag, no marker), bypassing the new check. The marker-post path retries via `gh_retry`, and the implement commit-time guard still catches the actual edit, but auto-approval itself would not be withheld.
